title: The Concept of Cognitive Dissonance
text:
Cognitive dissonance is a psychological concept describing the mental discomfort experienced by a person who holds two or more contradictory beliefs, ideas, or values, or when confronted by an action that contradicts their core beliefs. The magnitude of this discomfort is proportional to the importance of the conflicting elements.

The theory posits that individuals are motivated to reduce this inconsistency in order to achieve psychological equilibrium. Reduction can occur through several mechanisms: changing one's behavior (which is often the most difficult method), altering one's belief system, or adding new cognitions that rationalize the conflict and diminish the perceived contradiction.
